text: pid's judge is one search: 152 s over 1.1 million originals at 96 cores. Drawing the profmark split costs about a minute with create-profmark --onlysplit. The toy's assembly after it takes about 22 s, most of it drawing 80,000 of TrEMBL's 149.4 million sequences to thin to 20,000 length-matched decoys.
